description: Work with Kyriba treasury data: bank accounts, cash and bank statement balances, cash flows, payment transfers and files, third parties and process templates, and start workflows when cash flows, payments or accounts change.

kyriba_bank_account_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a bank account's details change in Kyriba, such as its IBAN, name or status. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.account: The whole account as Kyriba lists it.
output.closing_date: The date it was closed, if it is.
output.company: The code of the company that owns it.
output.iban: The IBAN, when it has one.
output.uuid: The account's UUID, for 'Get bank account'.

parameters.description: Only accounts of this company, by code or UUID. Leave empty for every company.
parameters.name: company

kyriba_bank_account_closed_trigger.description: Runs each time a bank account is closed in Kyriba. Ones closed before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.account: The whole account as Kyriba lists it.
output.closing_date: The date it was closed, if it is.
output.company: The code of the company that owns it.
output.iban: The IBAN, when it has one.
output.uuid: The account's UUID, for 'Get bank account'.

parameters.description: Only accounts of this company, by code or UUID. Leave empty for every company.
parameters.name: company

kyriba_new_bank_account_trigger.description: Runs for each new bank account in Kyriba. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.account: The whole account as Kyriba lists it.
output.closing_date: The date it was closed, if it is.
output.company: The code of the company that owns it.
output.iban: The IBAN, when it has one.
output.uuid: The account's UUID, for 'Get bank account'.

parameters.description: Only accounts of this company, by code or UUID. Leave empty for every company.
parameters.name: company

kyriba_new_bank_statement_balance_trigge.description: Runs when a new end-of-day bank statement balance reaches Kyriba for a bank account. Balances there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.amount: The end-of-day balance Kyriba gives for today.
output.statement_date: The day of the new statement balance.

parameters.description: The account to watch, by code or UUID.
parameters.name: account

kyriba_new_cash_flow_trigger.description: Runs for each new cash flow in Kyriba. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 10,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.account: The code of the account it is on.
output.cash_flow: The whole cash flow as Kyriba lists it.
output.signed_amount: The amount, negative for money going out.
output.uuid: The cash flow's UUID, for 'Get cash flow'.

parameters.description: Only cash flows on this account, by code or UUID. Leave empty for every account.
parameters.name: account

parameters.description: Only cash flows with this status: ESTIMATED, CONFIRMED, ACTUAL (such as reconciled bank transactions) or INTRADAY. Leave empty for every status.
parameters.name: status

kyriba_new_payment_file_trigger.description: Runs for each new payment file in Kyriba. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 5,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.next_action: What has to happen next, such as SIGN_LEVEL1.
output.payment_file: The whole payment file as Kyriba lists it.
output.status: Its status, such as RELEASED, TRANSMITTED or REJECTED.
output.uuid: The payment file's UUID, for 'Get payment file log'.

kyriba_new_third_party_trigger.description: Runs for each new third party in Kyriba. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.name: The third party's name.
output.third_party: The whole third party as Kyriba lists it.
output.uuid: The third party's UUID, for 'Get third party'.

kyriba_new_transfer_trigger.description: Runs for each new transfer in Kyriba. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 5,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.file_name: The payment file it came in.
output.next_action: What has to happen next, such as SIGN_LEVEL_1.
output.status: Its status, such as REGISTERED, REMITTED, EXECUTED or REJECTED.
output.transfer: The whole transfer as Kyriba lists it.

parameters.description: Only transfers from this payment file. Leave empty for every transfer.
parameters.name: file_name

kyriba_payment_file_status_changed_trigg.description: Runs each time a payment file's status changes in Kyriba, such as to TRANSMITTED, REJECTED or VALID. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 5,000 payment files. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.next_action: What has to happen next, such as SIGN_LEVEL1.
output.payment_file: The whole payment file as Kyriba lists it.
output.status: Its status, such as RELEASED, TRANSMITTED or REJECTED.
output.uuid: The payment file's UUID, for 'Get payment file log'.

kyriba_third_party_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a third party (a supplier, customer or other counterparty) changes in Kyriba. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.name: The third party's name.
output.third_party: The whole third party as Kyriba lists it.
output.uuid: The third party's UUID, for 'Get third party'.

kyriba_transfer_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a payment transfer's status changes in Kyriba, such as to EXECUTED or REJECTED. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 5,000 transfers. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.file_name: The payment file it came in.
output.next_action: What has to happen next, such as SIGN_LEVEL_1.
output.status: Its status, such as REGISTERED, REMITTED, EXECUTED or REJECTED.
output.transfer: The whole transfer as Kyriba lists it.

parameters.description: Only transfers from this payment file. Leave empty for every transfer.
parameters.name: file_name
